subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this Trim OS packaged Gateway auth/config report be handled as a core Gateway repair, routed to the package owner, or held until logs identify the exact failing connect frame?
rationale: The possible fixes touch Gateway device pairing, shared auth, and loopback bypass behavior, while the reported config regeneration may be outside this repository.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted WebSocket/gateway logs, the failing `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before selecting a code or package fix.

options.title: Core diagnostic repair
options.body: If logs show a current OpenClaw client produces an opaque protocol or auth failure, improve the Gateway/CLI diagnostic path without loosening pairing.

options.title: Route package config behavior
options.body: If only `trim.openclaw` config regeneration reproduces, keep core auth unchanged and route persistence behavior to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted WebSocket/gateway logs, the failing `connect` protocol range, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before selecting a code or package fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Gateway auth/pairing protocol and docs surface that would frame this security-boundary decision.
